checkpoints.description: [1/4] Decode chunked request bodies with bounded reads and size limits

impact_assessment.why: A verified probe shows chunked POSTs are rejected with 400, so a sender using Transfer-Encoding: chunked cannot be captured at all.
impact_assessment.benefits: Postbox captures bodies from standard HTTP clients that stream without Content-Length.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: chunked changes from 400 to accepted, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: the decoder runs before the store lock and cannot block it; state: a malformed stream must never produce a partial record.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound every readline, cap the accumulated body at max_body, return 400/413 before constructing a record, and use raw-socket known-answer tests.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Faithful replay: --preserve-path uses captured path and query with the target host

impact_assessment.why: Replay currently discards the captured path and query, so it cannot reproduce the endpoint that was actually called.
impact_assessment.benefits: A replay can target a different host while exercising the original route and query string.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: opt-in flag, so default behaviour is unchanged; dependency: stdlib urllib only; concurrency: none; state: redacted query values must never be replayed.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compose the URL from parsed components, omit a query containing the redaction marker, and add a known-answer test against a local server.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Targeted delete by id with the existing ambiguity guard

impact_assessment.why: There is no way to remove one captured request; clear wipes the whole inbox, which is too coarse for a noisy webhook stream.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can discard a single noisy capture without losing the rest of the evidence.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new command only; dependency: none; concurrency: delete must hold the same store lock as append and trim; state: a partial delete must not corrupt the JSONL file.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Implement delete as an atomic rewrite under the existing lock, reuse find() ambiguity detection, and add failing-first tests for not-found, ambiguous and successful removal.
